headword: {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}

definitions.explanation: An approximate amount in the range of roughly two to nine million yen (about US$15,000–60,000). Uses the prefix {数|すう} (several) to give a rough estimate rather than an exact figure.

examples.japanese: {修理費|しゅうりひ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The repair costs came to several million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: Many households have an annual income of several million yen.

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺|さぎ}→詐欺：09789_sagi⟧⟦{被害|ひがい}→被害：02572_higai⟧にあった⟦{高齢者|こうれいしゃ}→高齢者：15649_koureisha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{老後|ろうご}→老後：15131_rougo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}え→蓄え：13993_takuwae⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{失|うしな}った→失う：01887_ushinau⟧。
examples.english: The elderly fraud victim lost several million yen from their retirement savings.

notes:
Formed from ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several) + ⟦{百万|ひゃくまん}→百万：08109_hyakuman⟧ (one million) + ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧ (yen). The prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ denotes a rough, unspecified count, typically between two and nine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}⟦{単位|たんい}→単位：03412_tani⟧: in units of millions of yen
- {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{損害|そんがい}→損害：02615_songai⟧: damages of several million yen
- {数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{借金|しゃっきん}→借金：03203_shakkin⟧: debt of several million yen
- ⟦{年収|ねんしゅう}→年収：05504_nenshuu⟧{数百万円|すうひゃくまんえん}: an annual income of several million yen
